احتقرا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَقَرَا (iḥtaqarā) /iħ.ta.qa.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# اُحْتُقِرَا (uḥtuqirā) /uħ.tu.qi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# اِحْتَقِرَا (iḥtaqirā) /iħ.ta.qi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
